 Role description 
This company has over 450 respectable clients in the entertainment industry. Their clients are manufacturers of games which need to be tested according to international legislation and standards. 
You will either work for the department focusing on iGaming testing or for the department focusing on embedded testing. 
The department Embedded Testing focuses on hardware and software testing. The software is mainly written in C++. The testing process needs to be thoroughly documented. Every week new machines need to be tested so you have a nice variety in your job. You will learn on the job until you have mastered the complete process resulting in all-round testing experience. 
For the department of iGaming you will be responsible for testing online applications, websites and games, mainly written in Java and Python.

The Role 
As a RF / Microwave Engineer you will bring deep signal-integrity and high-frequency design expertise into our Product Development team. You will own the microwave performance of our products from concept through validation, combining simulation, measurement and product development.

RF Design & Simulation - Perform 3D EM simulations of next-generation interconnects and transitions - Design microwave filters and attenuators - Perform microwave budget and cascade analysis - Validate simulations against measurements - Shape RF architecture of next-generation products 
Technical Ownership & Collaboration - Review third-party simulation models and measurement data - Support customer projects with RF expertise - Actively collect, analyze and translate feedback from customers, partners and suppliers, inside and outside of Europe - Define product roadmaps and specifications - Contribute to product documentation - Cross-functional collaboration 
What you bring - 5-10 years of working experience of which at least 4+ years working as RF / microwave expert - Knowledge of transmission lines, S-parameters, matching, filters and attenuators - Experience with HFSS, CST or similar 3D EM tools - Experience correlating simulations with RF measurements - Collaborative mindset and good English

Join our dynamic team as a warehouse employee at Zara in Maastricht, where you can work flexibly and part-time in the heart of the city. With shifts ranging from 3 to 8 hours per week, you can easily balance this job with your studies or another position. You'll earn a competitive salary of €14.99 per hour. Your day begins with unpacking deliveries, sorting clothing and accessories, and ensuring everything is neatly stored in the warehouse. Throughout your shift, you'll help maintain organization and ensure the store is well-stocked. Collaborate with colleagues and handle tasks independently, finishing your shift by keeping the area clean and tidy. This role is perfect for those who enjoy staying active and seeking variety in their work. No experience is necessary; a positive attitude is what matters most. Apply now and contribute to the smooth running of logistics in the center of Maastricht!
